notes: Table conductivity_sc: Table 2, p. 29. Effective conductivity of the simple cubic array of spherical inclusions, over that of the matrix.
The columns contrast_0 to contrast_infinity are the conductivity of the spheres over that of the matrix; contrast_infinity stands for perfectly conducting spheres.
